speaking.title: 帮客户订酒店
speaking.content:
You: Good morning, Mr. Smith! Have you settled in well? How's the hotel?
Client: Good morning! Yes, the room is lovely. Thank you for arranging it.

dialogue.text: Good morning, Mr. Smith! Have you settled in well? How's the hotel?
Good morning! Yes, the room is lovely. Thank you for arranging it.
I'm glad you like it. I chose a room with a city view — the night scenery here is quite beautiful.
Oh, I noticed! The skyline at night is stunning. Great choice!
If you need anything — laundry, gym access, or restaurant recommendations — just let me know.

speaking.phrases: settle in 安顿下来; city view 城市景观; just let me know 随时告诉我
speaking.culturalTips: 中东客户篇：尊重宗教习惯，注意祈祷时间；握手礼仪：中东男性通常不和女性握手

speaking.title: 商务会议开场白
speaking.content:
You: Good morning everyone, let's get started with today's agenda.
Client: Sure, I'd like to go over the quarterly report first.

dialogue.text: Good morning everyone, let's get started with today's agenda.
Sure, I'd like to go over the quarterly report first.
Of course. I've sent everyone the updated numbers — let me pull them up on screen.
Great. I noticed the Q2 figures are slightly below projections. Can you walk us through that?
Absolutely. The main factor was the supply chain delay in March, which pushed about 15% of orders into Q3.

speaking.phrases: get started 开始; go over 回顾/检查; quarterly report 季度报告; walk us through 带我们过一遍; pull up on screen 投到大屏
speaking.culturalTips: 英式英语中常用 'Shall we begin?' 替代 'Let's get started'; 会议上直视对方表明你在倾听

speaking.title: 面试自我介绍
speaking.content:
You: Tell me about yourself and your professional background.
Client: I have five years of experience in digital marketing, specializing in content strategy.

dialogue.text: Tell me about yourself and your professional background.
I have five years of experience in digital marketing, specializing in content strategy and social media management.
That's impressive. How do you measure the success of a content campaign?
I track key metrics like engagement rate, conversion rate, and ROI. In my last role, I increased organic traffic by 40% within six months.
What tools do you typically use for analytics and reporting?
I'm proficient in Google Analytics, Tableau, and HubSpot. I also use A/B testing to optimize content performance.

speaking.phrases: professional background 职业背景; specializing in 专攻; engagement rate 参与率; conversion rate 转化率; proficient in 精通
speaking.culturalTips: 面试时保持 eye contact 表明自信; 用 STAR 法则回答行为问题 (Situation, Task, Action, Result)

speaking.title: 客户电话跟进
speaking.content:
You: I'm calling to follow up on the proposal we sent last week.
Client: Thanks for following up. We've reviewed it and have a few questions.

dialogue.text: I'm calling to follow up on the proposal we sent last week. Have you had a chance to review it?
Thanks for following up. We've reviewed it and have a few questions about the pricing structure.
Of course, I'd be happy to clarify. What specific aspects would you like me to address?
The tiered pricing seems a bit complicated. Can you simplify how it works for our team size?
Absolutely. Based on your team of 25, the middle tier would be most cost-effective at $49 per user per month.

speaking.phrases: follow up on 跟进; have a chance to 有机会; pricing structure 定价结构; cost-effective 性价比高的; per user per month 每月每人
speaking.culturalTips: 美国客户喜欢直接切入主题; 欧洲客户更注重建立关系后再谈业务

speaking.title: 餐厅点餐
speaking.content:
You: Hi, I'd like to order the grilled salmon with a side salad, please.
Client: Excellent choice! Would you like any drinks with that?

dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to order the grilled salmon with a side salad, please.
Excellent choice! Would you like any drinks with that?
I'll have a glass of sparkling water, please.
Sure. And for dessert, we have a wonderful tiramisu and a chocolate lava cake today.
The tiramisu sounds lovely, I'll go with that.

speaking.phrases: I'd like to order 我想点; side salad 配菜沙拉; sparkling water 气泡水; I'll go with that 我选那个
speaking.culturalTips: 英美餐馆一般要给15-20%小费; 法国和意大利服务费已包含在账单中(service compris)

speaking.title: 问路指路
speaking.content:
You: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the nearest subway station?
Client: Sure, just go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the traffic light.

dialogue.text: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the nearest subway station?
Sure, just go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the traffic light. You'll see the station entrance on your right.
About how long does it take to walk there?
It's about a 10-minute walk. There's also a bus stop right here — bus 42 goes directly there.

speaking.phrases: how to get to 怎么去; go straight 直走; turn left at the traffic light 红绿灯处左转; on your right 在你右手边
speaking.culturalTips: 英国用 underground/tube, 美国用 subway; 日本地铁站通常有日英双语标识

speaking.title: 机场登机
speaking.content:
You: Good morning, I'm checking in for flight CA123 to Beijing.
Client: May I see your passport and booking reference, please?

dialogue.text: Good morning, I'm checking in for flight CA123 to Beijing.
May I see your passport and booking reference, please?
Here you go. I'd prefer an aisle seat if possible.
Let me check... Yes, I can give you seat 28C, which is an aisle seat. How many bags are you checking in?
Just one suitcase, and I have this carry-on bag.

speaking.phrases: check in 办理登机; booking reference 预订编号; aisle seat 靠过道座位; carry-on bag 随身行李
speaking.culturalTips: 国际航班建议提前3小时到机场; 美国 TSA 安检需要脱鞋和取出笔记本电脑

speaking.title: 产品演示
speaking.content:
You: Welcome, everyone. Today I'll walk you through our latest product features.
Client: Before we start, could you explain how this integrates with our existing system?

dialogue.text: Welcome, everyone. Today I'll walk you through our latest product features and answer any questions you may have.
Before we start, could you explain how this integrates with our existing CRM system?
Great question. Our platform offers a one-click integration with Salesforce, HubSpot, and most major CRMs through our API.
How long does the integration typically take?
Most clients are up and running within 48 hours. Our support team handles the entire setup process.

speaking.phrases: walk through 演示/讲解; integrate with 与...集成; one-click 一键; up and running 运行起来; handles the entire process 全程负责
speaking.culturalTips: 演示时用短句和 bullet points 效果更好; 技术演示建议用 'let me show you' 代替 'I will tell you'

listening.title: TED: The Power of Vulnerability
listening.content: Brené Brown discusses how vulnerability is the birthplace of innovation and creativity. She spent years studying human connection and discovered that embracing vulnerability is the key to a fulfilling life.
listening.exercises: 听后回答：What is the main message of this talk? How does vulnerability connect to creativity?

listening.title: BBC: The English We Speak — 'A Piece of Cake'
listening.content: Learn what 'a piece of cake' really means and how to use it in British English. This idiom means something is very easy, and it's commonly used in both casual and professional settings.
listening.exercises: 请用 'a piece of cake' 造3个句子，并和 'easy as pie' 对比使用场景

listening.title: VOA: Business English — Negotiation Skills
listening.content: Key phrases and strategies for successful business negotiations in English. Learn how to make counter-offers, handle objections, and close deals confidently.
listening.exercises: 学习并练习商务谈判中的常用句型：I'd like to propose... / What if we... / Could we meet halfway on...

listening.title: BBC: 6 Minute English — Climate Change Vocabulary
listening.content: Discussion about climate change vocabulary and environmental terms. Learn words like carbon footprint, renewable energy, and sustainability.
listening.exercises: 听后列出5个环境相关词汇，并用每个词造一个句子

listening.title: TED: How Great Leaders Inspire Action
listening.content: Simon Sinek explains the Golden Circle concept: Start with Why. He shows how the most inspiring leaders and organizations communicate from the inside out.
listening.exercises: What is the Golden Circle? How does the 'Why-How-What' framework apply to leadership and marketing?

listening.title: VOA: Words and Their Stories — 'Take the Bull by the Horns'
listening.content: Explore the origin and usage of this bold idiom. Learn what it means to 'take the bull by the horns' and how to use it in everyday conversation.
listening.exercises: 听后请解释：这个习语的起源是什么？在现代场景中你会怎么使用它？

listening.title: BBC: Business Daily — Remote Work Revolution
listening.content: How the shift to remote work is changing global business practices. Key vocabulary includes: hybrid model, async communication, digital nomad, and zoom fatigue.
listening.exercises: 听后列出远程办公的3个优点和3个挑战；用 hybrid model 造句

listening.title: TED-Ed: The benefits of a bilingual brain
listening.content: Mia Nacamulli explains how knowing more than one language keeps your brain healthy, complex, and actively engaged.
listening.exercises: 听力理解：双语大脑有哪些好处？你认为成年人学习第二语言和儿童有什么不同？

We use industry benchmarks to measure our performance.
All stakeholders need to be informed about the policy changes.
We need a scalable solution that can grow with the company.
The startup decided to pivot from B2C to B2B.
Our team follows agile methodology for faster delivery.
